metadata.notes: Current-generation models offered as pre-fills when an administrator adds an AI provider in VSWarehouse. Servers fetch this file so the suggested models stay current without a server upgrade; a snapshot ships in the server image as a fallback for deployments without outbound access. Suggestions only — administrators can always type any model id, including private or fine-tuned models. Set minServerVersion on a provider (or bump it) when an entry needs server code that older releases do not have.
